name: 75206 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75206 (Dallas) has 225 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75206 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
